title: Nectar de gingembre (Ginger Drink)
author: Tata Ngome et al. (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré)
desc: Two kilograms of ginger washed, cut, crushed and pressed, the juice filtered and boiled 10 minutes with 2 kg of sugar and 6 litres of water, cooled and bottled in sterilised containers.
longDesc: p. 80 of the October 2023 recipe book: 2 kg ginger, 2 kg sugar and 6 litres of water. The ginger is washed, cut small, crushed and pressed; the juice is filtered; water and sugar are added and it boils 10 minutes; cool; bottle in sterilised containers; keep cool. The page says the drink is much liked by adults and is generally ginger juice, sugar and water. The diagram says 75 °C, 10 min and shows ‘tourteau’; the text calls the ginger ‘le fruit’. Recorded as printed.
steps: Wash the ginger and cut it small.
Crush and press it. Filter the juice.
Add the water and sugar. Boil 10 minutes.
chefTips: The only printed cues are the 10-minute boil and sterilised bottles.
The diagram shows 75 °C for 10 minutes against ‘boil’ in the text — not reconciled.
storage: Keep cool. No shelf life is printed.
culturalNote: The book attributes its recipes to the northern part of Cameroon and names no community, lamidat or town for any recipe.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Nectar de gingembre’ (p. 80). Authors as printed: ‘Tata Ngome et al.’ (CIFOR-ICRAF, IRAD, Université de Ngaoundéré; ReSI-NoC project); October 2023 (V1), © 2024, CC BY 4.0. Yield not printed for any recipe in the book. Servings 25 and prep are placeholders. TWO-PASS.
CONFLICT (unreconciled): diagram shows 75 °C, 10 min and a ‘tourteau’ box; the text boils 10 minutes. ABSENT: shelf life.
